text: hm i dont know that its correct, i am getting two different color reads on the baseline plane without changing a thing to it yet
resolution: Diagnosed the two-tone baseline plane: dot colours measured depth along the RAW camera direction, so any view a few degrees off axis (including the compass top view, which stops at the ~86° pitch clamp) spread a genuinely flat plane across a hue ramp. Fixed with req_3066: the depth axis now snaps to the camera forward's dominant world axis.
